environment: synthetic Claudian views and commands; no native app, credentials or model request

checks.name: missing plugin has no available bridge and opens no command
2.3.21 metadata enables the observed compatibility adapter without touching settings, sessions or secrets
prefill invokes only the open-view command, appends once and focuses without a submit
unknown versions open the existing chat and use manual fallback without invoking its input method
explicit false readiness is retried but only a successful append changes the input
ambiguous append results and exceptions never retry a possibly completed append
readiness has a bounded timeout and absence of the observed method uses manual fallback
abort prevents opening or a later input append
a version change during readiness cancels the compatibility adapter
the prompt carries only explicit text/context, requests chat output and supplies task schemas
pasted JSON and fenced JSON become validated card/outline drafts without saving
plain replies preserve content as one editable card or Markdown document
Markdown outline preserves nested headings and notes while normalizing skipped levels
invalid, empty, oversized or ambiguous imports cannot create a draft
direct Claudian request streams only its ephemeral run without reading history or consuming the composer
2.3.24 direct request uses an isolated passive run while prefill stays unverified
2.3.30 direct request uses an isolated passive run while prefill stays unverified
2.3.30 forwards only explicitly attached images with text through the isolated passive session
image requests stop if Claudian changes to an unverified image adapter while initializing
unsupported image versions, remote URLs, malformed data and oversized attachments never start execution
Claudian reply sync reads the next newly completed turn and pins that conversation
unavailable models and unsupported versions fail before opening an execution session
cancel, timeout and provider invalidation stop a blocked stream and release its session
unfinished and provider-error streams cannot return a successful reply or expose backend errors
